Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Kristin Chair-and-a-Half Upholstered Sleeper Sofa, 55.5"W, Stone
Colors: Stone
Materials: stone
In addition to being a lovely accent piece for any room, this chair doubles as a pull-out twin bed perfect for hosting guests. Round arms and clean style give this chair modern and classic touches, allowing it to blend with most styles. 55.5"W and 72"D when unfolded into bed Solid hardwood and laminate wood frame; polyester/nylon performance fabric Modern casual Doubles as an accent chair and pull-out twin bed No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3 year warranty.
